task.title: October vendor payments
task.objective: Pay every October vendor invoice whose AP status is approved, in invoice order (INV-101 through INV-105), except INV-104 (Northwind Traders), which is on hold until the user releases it.
task.outcome: INV-101, INV-102, INV-103, and INV-105 are each paid exactly once for the invoice amount. INV-104 is unpaid until the user releases it, then paid once.

success_criteria.description: INV-104 (Northwind Traders, 5600.00) not paid until the user releases it.

includes: The five October invoices INV-101 to INV-105 listed by list_invoices.
excludes: Paying INV-104 before the user explicitly releases it.
Paying any invoice whose AP status is not approved.

completed.description: Listed invoices (all five approved) and payments (none existed before this run).
Paid INV-101, 12400.00 to Acme Supply. Bank accepted it as PMT-5001.
Paid INV-102, 3150.00 to Globex Freight. Bank accepted it as PMT-5002.
Reported status to the user, including that INV-103 is unknown and that the user could check the bank portal.

focus.description: Determining whether the INV-103 payment (8900.00 to Initech Services) went through after a bank gateway timeout. The follow-up list_payments check failed because the backend connection was lost; no action was taken by that call.

next.description: Call list_payments and look for a payment against INV-103. Also confirm PMT-5001 and PMT-5002 are listed so INV-101 and INV-102 are not paid again.
Only if the payment list shows no INV-103 payment and INV-103 is still approved: pay INV-103 once for 8900.00.
After INV-103 is settled (paid exactly once), and if INV-105 is still approved and unpaid: pay INV-105 for 2275.00.
Keep INV-104 unpaid until the user releases it; then confirm it is still approved and unpaid, and pay 5600.00 once.
Pay INV-104 ($5,600.00); the user released the hold.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. A duplicate payment cannot be undone.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: Run the October vendor payments: pay every approved invoice, in invoice order.
Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104) for now; they are disputing a short delivery, and the user will say when to release it.

list_invoices returned five invoices, all with AP status approved: INV-101 Acme Supply 12400.00; INV-102 Globex Freight 3150.00; INV-103 Initech Services 8900.00; INV-104 Northwind Traders 5600.00; INV-105 Umbrella Logistics 2275.00.
Before any payment in this run, list_payments returned an empty list.

verification.method: Read from list_payments output before payments were sent; payments have been made since.

statements.text: pay_invoice for INV-101, amount 12400, returned: Payment PMT-5001 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-102, amount 3150, returned: Payment PMT-5002 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-103, amount 8900, returned: bank gateway timeout after 30 s; the payment status is unknown.
The follow-up list_payments call failed: the session ended (connection to the backend lost), and no action was taken. INV-103's outcome was never checked.
Do not resend INV-103 until the payment list shows whether the timed-out payment went through.
statements.rationale: The bank cannot reverse payments, so resending a payment that actually succeeded would pay Initech twice.

statements.text: Do not pay INV-105 until INV-103 is settled.
statements.rationale: The user asked for payments in invoice order, and INV-103 comes before INV-105.

statements.text: Did the INV-103 payment of 8900.00 to Initech Services go through despite the gateway timeout? Answerable from list_payments or by the user checking the bank portal.
Northwind resolved the dispute. Release the hold and pay INV-104.

resources.title: INV-104 Northwind Traders 5600.00 (on hold, disputed short delivery)
Bank payment list (system of record for whether INV-103 was paid)

resources.excerpt: INV-101 Acme Supply 12400.0 approved; INV-102 Globex Freight 3150.0 approved; INV-103 Initech Services 8900.0 approved; INV-104 Northwind Traders 5600.0 approved; INV-105 Umbrella Logistics 2275.0 approved
Error: bank gateway timeout after 30 s. The payment status is unknown.
Error: the session has ended (connection to the backend lost). No action was taken.

operations.description: pay_invoice INV-103 for 8900.00 to Initech Services. Sent once; the bank gateway timed out and the outcome is unknown.
pay_invoice INV-105 for 2275.00 to Umbrella Logistics. Not sent.
The user released the INV-104 hold.
operations.requested_from: the user who requested the payment run

operations.description: pay_invoice INV-104 for 5600.00 to Northwind Traders, only after the user releases it.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Reads the bank payment list; needed to settle INV-103's outcome.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to check the bank portal for an INV-103 payment and report the result.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.description: Re-check AP status is still approved before paying.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to confirm the invoice is still approved.

preconditions.description: The payment list (or the user, from the bank portal) shows definitively whether INV-103 was paid.
Each invoice about to be paid still has AP status approved.
The invoice about to be paid has no existing payment in the payment list (PMT-5001 and PMT-5002 cover INV-101 and INV-102).

stop_conditions.description: Do not call pay_invoice for INV-103 unless the payment list or the user confirms no INV-103 payment exists.
If the payment list shows a pending, partial, duplicate, or otherwise ambiguous INV-103 entry, stop and ask the user.

recovery.description: Call list_payments; confirm PMT-5001 and PMT-5002, and look for an INV-103 payment.
If INV-103 is absent and still approved, pay it once (8900.00), then pay INV-105 (2275.00) if still approved and unpaid. If INV-103 is present, pay only INV-105.
Report results to the user; INV-104 stays on hold.
